name: Running-hours meter
summary: A running-hours meter accumulates elapsed time while its specified enabling condition is active.
description: A running-hours meter accumulates elapsed time while its specified enabling condition is active. The schematic must show what condition is counted, such as a running feedback contact or an energised supply.
readingNotes: An energised meter supply and actual machine running are not always the same condition.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A running-hours meter measures duration; an operation counter counts events.
